common.waitlistBody: Leave your email and we'll write to you when campaigns open up.

sharedInbox.metaDescription: One inbox for every WhatsApp conversation: assignments, internal notes, roles and full history — on your own business number.
sharedInbox.title: One number, whole team, zero lost chats.
sharedInbox.sub: Every customer message lands in one inbox your whole team works from — assigned, answered and documented, on your official WhatsApp Business number.
sharedInbox.imageAlt: The WeizChat inbox: a team conversation list and an open chat with the customer panel.

f1.title: Assignments & statuses
f1.body: Route each conversation to an owner, track new, open and resolved, and see at a glance who is on it.

f2.title: Internal notes
f2.body: Discuss a conversation privately, next to the conversation itself. Customers never see notes — the system enforces it.

f3.title: Live for everyone
f3.body: Two agents, one truth: updates appear for the whole team in real time, in two browsers or twenty.

f4.title: The 24-hour window, visible
f4.body: The inbox shows when the free-reply window closes and switches you to approved templates when it does.

f5.title: Search & filters
f5.body: Find any customer by name or number; filter the inbox by assignee or status.

f6.title: Roles & permissions
f6.body: Administrators and agents see and do exactly what their role allows — nothing more.

aiSalesAgent.metaDescription: Weizic answers customers instantly with real catalog prices, follows the rules you write, and escalates to a human when unsure.
aiSalesAgent.title: Answers like your best agent. Escalates like your most careful one.
aiSalesAgent.sub: Weizic reads the customer's question, finds the exact product in your catalog, quotes the real price — and brings in a human the moment confidence drops or policy demands it.
aiSalesAgent.imageAlt: The AI Sales Agent settings page: readiness score, quick-start business types and business details.

f1.title: Real prices only
f1.body: Prices and stock come from your product data. Weizic never invents a price — no confident match, no quote.

f2.title: Product identification
f2.body: A photo, a model name or a serial number is enough to start the search in your catalog.

f3.title: Your rules, versioned
f3.body: Behavior profile, rules and playbooks are written and approved by you. The AI never edits its own instructions.

f4.title: You choose the autonomy
f4.body: Fully autonomous, facts-only, or draft-only — where every reply waits for human approval.

f5.title: Hard escalation triggers
f5.body: Complaints, legal topics, payment issues and low confidence go straight to your team, with full context.

f6.title: Every run audited
f6.body: Every AI decision is recorded — what it saw, what it did, and why.

aiSalesAgent.honest: A human can take over any conversation at any moment — and everything the AI sends passes the same checks as a human reply: messaging window, quota, permissions.

chatbot.metaDescription: Greet after hours, offer a short menu, route to the right team and hand off to a human — honestly, without pretending.
chatbot.title: Answer at 2am — without pretending to be a person.
chatbot.sub: A first reply, a short menu and smart routing keep customers moving when the team is away — and hand over cleanly the moment an agent arrives.
chatbot.imageAlt: The chatbot settings: greeting, menu options and hand-off to a human.

f1.title: Instant first reply
f1.body: Greet every new conversation with your message and a short menu of options.

f2.title: Routing
f2.body: Each menu choice can answer on its own, or hand the conversation to the right team.

f3.title: Quiet when you type
f3.body: The moment an agent replies in a conversation, the bot goes silent there — automatically.

f4.title: Lifecycle automations
f4.body: Rules that run once per conversation — welcomes, follow-ups, closing actions — with per-action failure reporting.

f5.title: Works with Weizic
f5.body: When the AI is on, it answers first; the menu bot backs it up for what's left.

f6.title: One switch
f6.body: An organization-wide switch stops every bot instantly. Control stays with you.

chatbot.honest: Automations can do nothing a human agent couldn't do — same permissions, same message rules, same limits.

crm.metaDescription: Customer cards that fill themselves from real conversations: custom fields, tags, notes and full history.
crm.title: The customer card that fills itself.
crm.sub: Every first message creates a customer. Every conversation lands on their card. Nothing to install, nothing to sync.
crm.imageAlt: The customers directory: names, masked numbers, labels and CSV import/export.

f1.title: Auto-created customers
f1.body: A new number writes in — a customer record exists. No manual entry.

f2.title: Names from WhatsApp
f2.body: The customer's WhatsApp profile name fills in automatically — and never overwrites a name you set yourself.

f3.title: Custom fields
f3.body: Define the fields your business needs and filter by them.

f4.title: Tags & segments
f4.body: Tag customers and build the audiences your campaigns will use.

f5.title: Notes & ownership
f5.body: Team notes and an assigned owner on every customer.

f6.title: Import & export
f6.body: Bring customers in by CSV and take them out the same way. Your data stays yours.

integrations.metaDescription: The official WhatsApp Business Platform at the core, your product catalog, and AI by Anthropic — with roadmap items labeled honestly.
integrations.title: Built on the platform. Connected to your stack.
integrations.sub: WeizChat connects to the official WhatsApp Business Platform and to the systems your catalog lives in — labeled honestly: live today, or on the roadmap.
integrations.imageAlt: The WhatsApp connection page: a connected number and write-only credential fields.

f1.title: WhatsApp Business Platform — live
f1.body: The core connection: official Cloud API, embedded signup or manual credentials, write-only token storage.

f2.title: Product catalog — live
f2.body: A structured product editor inside WeizChat feeds Weizic real prices and stock.

f3.title: AI by Anthropic — live
f3.body: Weizic runs on Anthropic's Claude models, behind a permissioned, tenant-scoped tool gateway.

f4.title: Google Sheets sync — coming soon
f4.body: Keep your catalog in a spreadsheet and sync it into WeizChat. On the roadmap.

f5.title: ERP & accounting — coming soon
f5.body: Product-data and accounting connections are planned next — tell us which system you use.

integrations.honest: If it isn't marked live, it doesn't exist yet. Roadmap is labeled roadmap.

campaigns.metaDescription: Template campaigns to opted-in audiences with honest delivery stats. Join the waitlist.
campaigns.title: Broadcasts that respect the rules.
campaigns.sub: Approved templates, opted-in audiences built from tags, resumable sending and honest delivery stats — opening to customers soon.

f1.title: Approved templates only
f1.body: Campaign messages are Meta-approved templates. The platform enforces it.

f2.title: Opt-in audiences
f2.body: Audiences are built only from customers who allow delivery — blocked customers are never included in the first place.

f3.title: Honest measurement
f3.body: Sent, delivered, read, replied — real numbers from real delivery statuses.

f4.title: Quota-aware
f4.body: Campaign quotas are enforced up front, and live customer replies are never blocked by a campaign.

pricing.metaDescription: Simple plans for a shared WhatsApp inbox with an AI sales agent. Meta's conversation fees are charged separately by Meta.
pricing.title: Pricing that says what it costs.
pricing.sub: Every plan includes the whole product — the plan only sets how many campaign messages and AI replies you use each month.

free.name: Free
free.who: For trying it out on a real number

pro.name: Pro
pro.who: For a team that answers all day

pricing.metaNote: On top of your subscription, Meta charges for conversations directly, at its own published rates. Those fees are billed by Meta, not by us, and we add nothing on top of them.
pricing.paymentsNote: Online self-serve payment is not live yet, so we set accounts up personally — write to us and we will get you started, including the free plan.
pricing.includedBody: We don't lock features behind tiers. The whole product is in every plan; the plan sets your monthly volume.

whoCharges.q: What exactly does Meta charge for?
whoCharges.a: Meta bills per 24-hour conversation, at rates that depend on the category and the country. Those rates are published by Meta and can change; we always point you to Meta's own pricing page rather than quoting numbers that may be out of date.

overQuota.q: What happens if I pass my monthly quota?
overQuota.a: Campaign sending pauses for the rest of the month and admins are notified — and if the AI reaches its cap it stops answering while your team keeps working. Live replies from humans are never blocked by a quota.

switch.a: Yes. Plans are monthly volumes, not contracts on features, so moving up or down takes effect for the following month.

trial.a: Start on the free plan with your own WhatsApp Business Account. You will need a number you control and a Meta Business account — we walk you through the connection.

contact.metaDescription: Talk to the WeizChat team about a demo, a trial or a question. Company details, phone and support email.
contact.title: Talk to us.
contact.sub: A demo, a question about connecting your number, or help choosing a plan — a person answers.
contact.formSub: Tell us a little about your business and what you want WhatsApp to do for it.
contact.supportBody: Write from the email address on your account and mention your organization name — it gets to the right place faster.
contact.privacyBody: For access, correction or deletion of personal data, write to the same address and say so in the subject. See the data deletion page for the full process.

hero.title: No WhatsApp customer left waiting.

problem.title: Business WhatsApp without a system is chaos.

scattered.title: Scattered conversations
scattered.body: Customers write to employees' personal phones — the business never sees the conversation.

noHistory.title: No ownership, no history
noHistory.body: When an agent leaves, their chats, contacts and open deals leave with them.

waiting.title: Customers wait for hours
waiting.body: By the time someone answers, the customer has already bought somewhere else.

inbox.title: Shared team inbox
inbox.body: Every conversation in one place — assignments, statuses and internal notes. Each agent sees exactly what they need.

ai.title: AI sales agent
ai.body: Weizic answers instantly, identifies products, quotes real catalog prices — and knows when to hand over to a person.

bot.title: Chatbot & automation
bot.body: After-hours replies, routing and lifecycle automations — without losing the human touch.

ai.title: From a photo to a quote — on its own.

photo.title: A customer sends a photo or serial
photo.body: A picture of a product, a model name or a serial number — the way customers actually write.

research.title: Weizic finds the exact model
research.body: The AI researches your own catalog to match the exact product.

answer.title: Real price, real stock
answer.body: The reply carries product, SKU, price and stock from your data. Weizic never invents a price.

escalate.title: Not sure? A human steps in
escalate.body: Low confidence or a sensitive request — the conversation escalates to your team with full context.

ai.honest: A human agent can take over any conversation, at any moment. Always.

platform.title: Built on the official platform
platform.body: WeizChat works with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) — no workarounds, no risk to your number.

cloudApi.title: Official Cloud API
cloudApi.body: The connection runs through Meta's official API, with a WhatsApp Business Account you own.

templates.title: Template messages
templates.body: Reaching out first happens with message templates approved by Meta in advance.

optIn.title: Opt-in first
optIn.body: Messages go only to customers who agreed to hear from you — WhatsApp policy, and good business.

greenTick.title: Verified business
greenTick.body: Businesses that meet Meta's criteria can apply for the official verified badge.

pricing.title: Conversation-based pricing
pricing.body: Meta bills per conversation, separately from your subscription. We explain exactly how it works.

service.label: Customer service
service.a: Every incoming question lands in one queue and is assigned to an available agent.
service.b: Weizic answers the routine ones — opening hours, order status, return policy.
service.c: Internal notes on every conversation, invisible to the customer.

sales.label: Sales
sales.a: A customer asks about a product — Weizic identifies it and quotes the catalog price.
sales.b: Complex deals escalate to a salesperson with the full conversation history.
sales.c: No lead disappears: every conversation is on the customer's card.

marketing.label: Marketing
marketing.a: Campaigns with approved templates, sent to audiences filtered by tags.
marketing.b: Honest measurement: sent, delivered, read, replied.
marketing.c: A campaign reply lands straight in the shared inbox as a live conversation.

crm.title: A simple CRM, already inside
crm.body: No extra system to buy: every customer gets a card with everything that matters.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.metaNote: On top of your subscription, Meta charges separately for conversations at its official rates. There are no hidden message fees from us.

waba.q: Do I need my own WhatsApp Business Account?
waba.a: Yes. You connect a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) that belongs to you — it stays yours, and we guide you through the setup.

charges.a: Meta bills conversation fees directly at its official rates. Your WeizChat subscription is separate and does not include Meta's charges.

keepNumber.q: Can I keep my existing number?
keepNumber.a: In most cases, yes. A number currently used in the WhatsApp app goes through a migration to the Business Platform — we walk you through it step by step.

data.a: Your data is isolated per organization, never sold, and deleted on request. The details are in our privacy policy and data deletion pages.

aiSafety.q: Can the AI say something wrong to my customers?
aiSafety.a: Weizic follows the rules and catalog you define, never invents a price, and asks or escalates when unsure. You can also switch it to draft-only mode, where a human approves every reply.

finalCta.title: See it answer on your own number.
finalCta.sub: Connect your WhatsApp Business Account and watch Weizic handle real conversations — with your team in control.
